notes: Answers: citystatezip is the city line as the IRS prints it ('San Jose, CA 95112', or province, country and postal code abroad). owner_id takes the owner's EIN; an individual owner's SSN or ITIN is never written and is added by hand. 'None' leaves a line blank (owner, parent, foreign country, late relief). check_if 'None' ticks nothing. effective is written MM/DD/YYYY. late_explanation fills Part II's nine lines, one sentence per line (or ';'). Only the first signature row's title is asked for; the signatures and dates, and the consent rows of other owners, are left for the signers. The XFA layer is dropped by the filler so the filled boxes show.
